subject: Packages of RHadoop family not available for R 3.2.3

messages.author: 717fd82035f587ca
messages.subject: Packages of RHadoop family not available for R 3.2.3
parts:
Rstudio is unable to connect to Hadoop. For all  the packages of RHadoop family, it says - 
Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/plyrmr/releases/download/0.6.0/plyrmr_0.6.0.tar.gz’ is not available (for R version 3.2.3)

I tried to get the packages from CRAN/RevolutionAnalytics, but no luck. 

I had an older version of R and all RHadoop packages worked earlier, but nothing works with R version 3.2.3. I thought they might work with Revolution
 R as Microsoft would want to restrict their uses to Microsoft Open R only, but nothing doing. Any idea if RHadoop packages work with R 3.2.3 and higher
versions of R?

messages.author: b74d47d59ad17fb5
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#2140] Packages of RHadoop family not available for R 3.2.3
parts:
The packages are not on cran, they are on github. 
You'd need to use the install_github function from the devtools package to install it. 
See http://stackoverflow.com/questions/29646482/how-to-install-rhadoop-packages-rmr-rhdfs-rhbase for a discussion.
